submission.justification: Crystal-K3 has the best resolution (2.9% in the 2025 simulation) but its intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is 4 times the 0.5 hard limit, so it is excluded. Crystal-K1 and Crystal-K2 both meet the limit. K1 has much better resolution than K2 (about 4.5% against 8.5% in the 2025 summary). I scanned K1 from 2 to 8 cm. The best values were 4.40% at 6 cm and 4.43% at 5 cm. Resolution was worse at 7 cm (4.87%) and 8 cm (5.53%), and at 2-4 cm (4.6-5.1%). The 5 cm and 6 cm results differ by only 0.03 points, so the choice between them is marginal. I did not simulate K2 at any thickness in this session.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Among the crystals within budget, K1 at 6 cm gave 4.40% FWHM, the best of the thicknesses I simulated. K3 would be better but is excluded on background. K2 is about 8.5% (2025 summary, not re-simulated).
K1 measured 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day in the Q1 2026 assay. K3 measured 2.0 and fails.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
